To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the HTL approximation is a good one for the shear viscosity and flavor conductivity of a strongly coupled gauge theory at finite temperature, and that the HTL result is renormalization point sensitive.
the HTL approximation is a good one, but not a perfect one, for computing transport properties of large Nf gauge theories.

the shear viscosity and flavor-diffusion coefficients of large Nf gauge theories at finite temperature are given by the HTL results, to leading order, if the renormalization-point dependence of the leading order result is small.

the calculation of the transport coefficients in the large Nc, Nf gauge theory.
the study of the properties of matter under extreme conditions.
the calculation of transport coefficients for a strongly-coupled gauge theory.
